name: Monstera Deliciosa
description: Known for its large, perforated leaves, this tropical plant is also called the Swiss cheese plant.

name: Snake Plant
description: A very resilient plant with stiff, upright leaves, often variegated with yellow or white edges.

name: ZZ Plant
description: An incredibly low-maintenance plant with waxy, dark green leaves that tolerate low light.

name: Pothos
description: A popular vining plant with heart-shaped leaves that can thrive in a variety of conditions.

name: Spider Plant
description: Produces long, arching leaves with stripes and creates 'plantlets' that dangle from the main plant.

name: Fiddle Leaf Fig
description: Features large, violin-shaped leaves and can grow into a small indoor tree with proper care.

name: Peace Lily
description: Known for its elegant white spathes that look like flowers and its ability to tolerate low light.

name: Aloe Vera
description: A succulent with thick, fleshy leaves filled with a gel that has medicinal properties.

name: Cast Iron Plant
description: As its name suggests, this plant is nearly indestructible, thriving on neglect and low light.

name: Succulent Assortment
description: A mix of small, diverse plants with fleshy leaves, often drought-tolerant and easy to care for.
